expectations.text: Module docstring with one-line summary and usage example
Class docstring includes an Attributes: section
expectations.evidence: Lines 31-34: rate and capacity documented under Attributes:.
Both methods carry all three sections; __init__ documents ValueError too.

expectations.text: All """ docstrings with descriptive first lines ending in a period
expectations.evidence: 'Takes n tokens, blocking...', 'Initializes a full bucket.', etc.

expectations.text: Docstrings describe semantics without repeating annotated types
expectations.evidence: Args describe meaning and units ('Refill rate in tokens per second'), never 'float'/'bool' restated.

expectations.text: try_acquire Returns explains True/False; acquire documents blocking behavior
expectations.evidence: try_acquire: 'Nothing is consumed on failure'; acquire: blocking, timeout, and unfair-wakeup caveat documented.

expectations.text: Inline comments follow spacing rules and explain intent
expectations.evidence: Block comments only, all intent-bearing ('Sleep outside the lock so other threads can take or return tokens').
Class docstring line 28: 'All methods are safe to call from multiple threads.'
